task: Classify histologic grade in lung squamous cell carcinoma. Classes: well differentiated and moderately differentiated. Key H&E features include the extent of keratinization, intercellular bridges, preservation of squamous architecture, and the degree of nuclear pleomorphism and mitotic activity.

classes.0: Well differentiated squamous carcinoma with prominent keratinization, obvious intercellular bridges, and relatively preserved squamous maturation.
classes.1: Moderately differentiated squamous carcinoma with reduced keratinization, less orderly squamous maturation, and greater cytologic atypia.
